text: Okay, so that's it. These essentially are our elements of the network. We are used mostly to this object, right? This is what we typically use. This object already has got several wireless interfaces. That means that it's able to use several different wireless technologies. Inside here, as you may know, we have a Wi-Fi card. We have a Bluetooth interface, and we have the cellular interface, at least. And then we have typically also a near communication field technology, and other possible technologies may be there. Okay, so let's now try to put some order in all this complicated environment that is the wireless network. So we mentioned already several different types of environments. Let's try now to categorize the different wireless environments that we may have. How can we do that? We need to choose a criterion based on which we can classify our wireless networks. A possible criterion is coverage. What type of coverage a wireless technology provides.
